prompts.title: Upcoming at Family Church Students
prompts.setup: Lead these current ministry announcements with warmth and clarity. State only the details shown; do not guess a price or registration detail.

events.name: Church Prayer Night
events.when: Wednesday, October 7, 2026 · bus leaves at 5:45 PM
events.where: Bus from Family Church Windermere to Lakeside
events.detail: Save the date! We're going to the church-wide prayer night at Lakeside, and it's free. The bus leaves Family Church Windermere at 5:45 PM, and we'll be back around 8:30 PM.
events.action: Sign up for the bus on BAND and tell your parents tonight.

events.name: Student Be Class and Baptism Interest
events.detail: Students who want to learn about following Jesus, baptism, and belonging at Family Church can take our next Be Class on October 18.
events.action: Talk with a student pastor to get the class time and sign up.

events.name: Middle School Sundays
events.detail: Middle school students gather for teaching and connection, with worship service options at 8:30 or 11:00 AM.
events.action: Invite a middle school friend this Sunday and connect with a leader at check-in.

events.name: Join our BAND app
events.when: Ongoing · get the current ministry updates
events.detail: BAND is where our student ministry shares announcements and keeps families connected across the week. Join at band.us/n/aaafbdF364s34 or with invite code YS5-FNX-4T. An admin approves each join request.
events.action: Join Family Students (WN) on BAND with invite code YS5-FNX-4T.

events.name: Wednesday Nights at Lakeside
events.detail: Wednesday nights are where we hang out, worship together, and get into small groups. If you haven't been in a while, this is your week to come back, and bring a friend with you.
events.action: Come this Wednesday and bring a friend.

events.name: Church Prayer Night
events.where: Right here at Family Church Lakeside
events.detail: Save the date! The church-wide prayer night is happening right here at our Lakeside campus. There's no bus to catch. Just come join us on-site and pray with the whole church family.
events.action: Put October 7 on your calendar and tell your parents.
